title: Range against launch angle
brief: Range in metres up the side against launch angle in degrees along the bottom, for u = 20 m/s with no air resistance. Points at 0, 15, 30, 45, 60, 75 and 90 degrees.
html:
<script>
const u = 20, g = 9.8;
const samples = [0, 15, 30, 45, 60, 75, 90];
const c = Visual.chart({ x: [0, 90], y: [0, 45], xLabel: "Launch angle (degrees)", yLabel: "Range (m)" });
let theta = 0;

const rangeAt = deg => u * u * Math.sin(2 * deg * Math.PI / 180) / g;

function draw() {
  c.clear();
  const R = rangeAt(theta);
  const T = 2 * u * Math.sin(theta * Math.PI / 180) / g;
  const pts = samples.map(d => [d, rangeAt(d)]);

  // Smooth theoretical curve R = u^2 sin(2θ) / g, dashed for reference
  c.fn(x => rangeAt(x), { color: "var(--muted)", dashed: true });

  // Slide's sampled data points
  c.line(pts);
  c.dots(pts);

  // Highlight the selected angle
  c.dots([[theta, R]], { color: "var(--warn)" });
  c.vline(theta, `${theta}°`);
  c.label(theta, R, `${R.toFixed(1)} m`);

  c.readout([
    `Range = ${R.toFixed(1)} m`,
    `Time of flight = ${T.toFixed(2)} s`,
    `u = ${u} m/s, g = ${g} m/s²`
  ]);

  Visual.state(`At launch angle ${theta}°, with u = 20 m/s and no air resistance, the range is ${R.toFixed(1)} m; the maximum of 40.8 m occurs at 45°.`);
}

Visual.on("launch_angle", v => { theta = v; draw(); });
draw();
</script>
